name: Invertible Architectures on Inverse Problems Benchmark
description: Recent work demonstrated that flow-based invertible neural networks are promising tools for solving ambiguous inverse problems. Following up on this, we investigate how ten invertible architectures and related models fare on two intuitive, low-dimensional benchmark problems, obtaining the best results with coupling layers and simple autoencoders. We hope that our initial efforts inspire other researchers to evaluate their invertible architectures in the same setting and put forth additional benchmarks, so our evaluation may eventually grow into an official community challenge.
reputation: A niche, research-stage benchmark used in the invertible architectures community for low-dimensional inverse-problem evaluation; limited adoption beyond initial studies.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; small, low-dimensional tasks designed for architectural comparison rather than large-scale evaluation—risk of overfitting and not a community standard yet.
